item.title: World : Philippines Leads ASEAN Push On Carbon Markets
item.description: MANILA, Nov 13 (Bernama-PNA) -- The Philippines, through the Department of Finance (DOF), is leading regional efforts to develop and harmonise carbon markets across Southeast Asia, the Philippine News Agency (PNA) reported.

item.title: World : ASEAN-China COC Talks Face Hurdles Ahead Of Year-End Deadline â Analyst
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 13 (Bernama) -- Longstanding disputes, shifting geopolitical dynamics, and negotiation fatigue could derail efforts by ASEAN and China to conclude negotiations on the South China Sea Code of Conduct (COC) by end-2026, an analyst said.

item.title: General : Govt To Retain Minimum Entry Requirements For UEC Holders Seeking Admission To IPTS Medical Programmes - Fahmi
item.description: PUTRAJAYA, Nov 13 (Bernama) -- The government has agreed to maintain the minimum entry requirements for holders of the Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) seeking admission to medical programmes at private higher education institutions (IPTS), as stipulated before the amendments, said MADANI Government spokesman Datuk Seri Fahmi Fadzil.
